notes.title: GeoLight Release!!!
notes.notes:
In GeoLight players harness the raw energy of the cosmic to blast through endless waves of dynamic shapes. As an interstellar sentinel, your mission is to protect the digital realms from an ancient force corrupting the geometric order of the universe. Collect energy shards, upgrades weapons, and unlock powerful abilities to ascent into geometric mastery. Whether you’re actively defending or watching the chaos unfold the shapes never stop.

GeoLight is setup a as fun casual idle shooter with Roguelike features. You will die often and quickly, but you are able to get right back into the action with immense power ups and upgrades to continue the battle. With fun quick gameplay the action never stops and it’s hard to put down this fun game.
